observations.bloom: Night views remain restrained. Actual-pass HDR probe confirms radius 1.50 spreads further than 0.50.

observations.clouds: Forms visible below and above, volume opacity within, parallax on movement, self-shaded density; remains soft stratus.
observations.other_conditions: Rain, glass/slime, firefly patch, held pickaxe, blindness, Nether stage, Creative lava immersion and End stage inspected.
